hypotheses.S1_shapley_allocation_is_exact: Signed channel Shapley allocations sum to total derivative energy within relative error 1e-5.
hypotheses.S2_shapley_ranking_improves_static: Training Shapley ranking improves held-out R-squared at 256 channels for every active address relative to isolated-energy ranking.
hypotheses.S3_static_shapley512_is_sufficient: At least half of active addresses reach held-out derivative R-squared 0.90 with 512 fixed Shapley-ranked channels.
hypotheses.S4_oracle_shapley256_is_sufficient: At least half of active addresses reach held-out derivative R-squared 0.90 with 256 per-state Shapley-ranked channels.
hypotheses.S5_cooperative_ranking_transfers: Aggregate train/test Shapley score cosine is at least 0.80 for every active address.
hypotheses.S6_shapley_support_is_sparse: Median per-state absolute-Shapley effective support is at most 512 channels.
hypotheses.S7_sufficiency_remains_broad: The median smallest fixed Shapley rank reaching held-out R-squared 0.90 exceeds 512.
